rationale: Narrow quant-aware perturbation and EMA to the tensors that actually move the final int8+zlib score: quantized late-tail matrices and logits-path weights. This keeps float-kept/control tensors live, reduces late over-regularization from whole-model roundtrips, and stays aligned with the recurrent-tail/export endgame instead of smoothing exact-pass tensors that do not suffer quantization error.
title: Partial Tail Quant-Aware Roundtrip
